snippet.title: NO ENTRY - Club Bouncer Simulator
snippet.description:
You are a bouncer for Club NO ENTRY. It is infamous for it's exclusivity but that's what keeps it afloat. You will dealing with e-celebs, tech bros, corpo sharks, the terminally intoxicated, the broke, the compensator, the arm candy, and many other types of clubgoers. Thankfully you have a domineering manager, a lively DJ, an exotic bartender, and a bubbly bottle girl to help you keep the club cool and profitable. 

There is a lot behind the facade. You will meet a lot more colorful characters than in previous Jeistar games. 

My third game with a killer soundtrack, as usual. Kindly Wishlist it on steam and help me with my passive income.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4109610/NO_ENTRY/

I love you all
- jeijei

Press Kit: https://impress.games/press-kit/jeistar/no-entry
